T2: crude came from drilled wells (Drake 1859 used percussion drilling); percussion_drilling was a leaf
T4: underground galleries need portable light (Grimes Graves chalk lamps)
T4: coking presupposes coal as a fuel (new coal_fuel node)

Audit edge declined: milling_machine is generation 3 of the machine_tool family, the same generation as interchangeable_parts; D-044 R7 / D-047 forbid a same-family prerequisite of the same or a later generation. The historical point (Hall's milling) is kept in the audit record.

Missing bridge: socialism (A8 ideology) has no dependents, and central_planning requires only official_statistics and telegraph, so today a polity can found a Marxist-Leninist state without the socialist ideology it embodies. Adding socialism (dated 1825-1848, before 1922) closes the ideology-to-regime link, as fascism does for fascist_state. Note for the integrator: socialism is a D13 civic, so this edge lands only when D13 is imported.

The OR admitted a scripture-less route through canon_law alone, which contradicts the node's own capability (lay readers challenging clergy from the text). The new expression is the required core; no Age or tree crossing is involved.

old.prereq: (cuneiform OR hieroglyphic OR chinese_script) AND stamp_seal

new.prereq: (cuneiform OR hieroglyphic OR chinese_script) AND appointed_officials

applied.rationale: Replace stamp_seal with appointed_officials (causal: the count is an official act). Age A4 kept. emerged is null: suggest '~3,000 BCE Egyptian biennial count; 2 CE Han census'.

Replace appointed_officials with civil_service_examinations: it bridges the A6 examination node (whose only dependent is absolute_monarchy) to its modern successor. This group also hangs five A9 administrative nodes on merit_civil_service.
Turn the heavy-plough requirement into an OR with systematic law (the Roman colonate binding tenants to the soil), so the manor is reachable in Mediterranean economies.
The current AND forbids the node's own anchor case (the US public domain). federal_republic (1787 CE) predates 1862, A7 is earlier than A8; chronology and sweep are safe.
Replace arts_academies with court_patronage: museums are opened princely and scholarly cabinets. arts_academies keeps its new dependents in this file.
Replace railway by steam_rotary (or T7 steam_printing_press when integrated): the mass press is a product of steam printing, not of railways.
Add chartered_universities (new, A6) to make the institutional lineage explicit. The A6 sweep already forces it complete before A8, so this costs no extra pacing.

The node's description makes sickle harvesting the mechanism of domestication, yet sickle has no dependents. Adding it closes a missing bridge and gives the sickle a downstream role. sickle (~12,500 BCE) predates the node (~9,500 BCE).
Replace the non-causal dog edge with sedentary cultivation (~11,500 BCE predates ~8,500 BCE).

Route the iron requirement through the new A4 iron farm-tool node (forged shares, coulters); iron_bloomery remains an indirect prerequisite, so no capability is lost, and the A4 node stops being a leaf.
Bridge through the new A6 rotation node; ~800 CE predates ~1,650 CE.

Levallois is a prepared-core refinement of hard-hammer flaking; making knapping_oldowan its prerequisite gives the knapping family one root instead of two unrelated roots (both A1, Oldowan ~2.6 Mya precedes ~300 kya). Not a chronology edge: the prepared core is literally flaking applied with foresight.

Currently an isolated root and leaf. The Blombos evidence ties the two directly: silcrete was heat-treated precisely so it could be pressure-flaked (~75 kya, after heat treatment at ~164 kya). Pressure retouch of a fine blank presupposes improving the stone first. Remains a deliberate leaf (finishing technique).

new.prereq: kiln_updraft AND charcoal AND (copper_native OR ochre_processing)

applied.rationale: Reduction smelting needs charcoal: its carbon monoxide is the reductant and a wood fire cannot reach or hold reducing conditions. The node's own description says 'in a charcoal fire'. charcoal (A2, ~5,500 BCE) predates smelting (~5,000 BCE); charcoal already feeds iron_bloomery on the same grounds.

Replace crank_connecting_rod with trip_hammer (A5, ~40 BCE; prereq water_mill): water power with cams is the mechanism the node is named for, and the crank (general ~1,400) postdates the node's earliest date (~1,150).

Remove timber_frame: not causal, and dated 1,500 years after the node's own emerged date (contract §6 chronology). The textile workshop it requires (inst.textile_workshop) is not live, so the node gets a specialist-class effect.

Move to A8: emerged 1885 sits inside the Industrial window (~1750-1914), the Chicago school is a pre-1914 phenomenon, and all three prerequisites are A8. A9 placement delays the unlock by an entire Age with no causal reason.

Its own emerged date (~1,500 BCE, Rekhmire tomb) lies inside the A3 window (~3,500-1,200 BCE), so the A4 label contradicts the dating. Moving it fills the empty A3 energy cohort. Prerequisites (A1, A2) and dependents (cast_iron A5, blast_furnace_water A6) stay order-safe.

Add gearing: the post mill is defined by its right-angle drive, and water_mill does not imply gearing in this graph (its anchor is the gearless horizontal mill). gearing is A5 (~150 BCE), well before 1,180 CE.

Dated 1884 (Parsons), well inside A8 (1750-1914); all prerequisites are A8 and its impact (turbo-alternators, turbine liners, Dreadnought) is pre-1914. Dependents jet_engine and nuclear_power stay A9, so the move is order-safe.
The engine's fuel was town gas; without a gas-supply node the bridge is missing. The replacement keeps chemistry_quantitative transitively.

Add track_road: the road-building craft (causeway, drainage, graded track) is the lineage of the engineered road, and the infrastructure ladder is road_track -> road_built -> road_paved. Without the edge a polity can build paved roads without ever knowing trackways; both atoms are A2/A3, so no sweep or chronology risk.

Emerged 1890 (City and South London Railway) and the electric tram boom of 1888-1910 lie squarely in the A8 window; both prerequisites are A8 and its only dependent (high_speed_rail) is A9, so moving it to A8 breaks no edge.

old.prereq: surveying AND (cuneiform OR hieroglyphic OR chinese_script OR mesoamerican_script)

applied.rationale: The script clause is identical to the one surveying already carries, so removing it changes no closure and no route; it only removes noise. Effect: storage geometry.
Replace chinese_script with counting_rods: the Chinese route then passes through the rod arithmetic the abacus actually mechanised. A deliberate leaf: an end-user computing aid.

Add electrostatics (new A7 node): Volta's pile (1800) grew out of Galvani's experiments and Volta's electrophorus and electroscope. The science of charge comes before the current; calculus alone leaves electricity without an ancestor.
Move A9 to A8 by its own dates (1896-1898, wholly before 1914). Both prerequisites are A8 and all four dependents are A9, so no edge breaks and nothing is blocked by the Age sweep.

Drop chinese_script from the OR: the alphabet derives from Egyptian hieroglyphs via Proto-Sinaitic, with cuneiform as the parallel Levantine scribal tradition. A Chinese-script player loses nothing reachable: both remaining atoms are A3 and the A5 sweep requires them anyway.

new.prereq: herbal_remedies AND (cuneiform OR hieroglyphic OR chinese_script)

applied.rationale: Add herbal_remedies: the earliest medical texts are mostly plant prescriptions (the Sumerian tablet, Ebers papyrus); what they write down is herbal lore. Script OR kept.
Move A9 to A8 by its own date (1895, Röntgen) and by its use by 1914; all prerequisites are A7-A8 and all four dependents are A9, so no edge or sweep is affected.
Add physiology: ORT rests on the 1960s discovery of sodium-glucose co-transport in the gut. Cost 740 is 0.016x the A9 median, an extreme outlier; recalibrate.
Replace guided_munitions with guided_missile AND computer: the interceptor lineage is the guided missile, and fire control is computed. Closure barely changes (laser drops out).

review.why: Cross-group duplicate (C1 vs C2), both A1: scattered bands meet at a place each season to hold rites, exchange news and find spouses. Same capability (seasonal band aggregation); seasonal_aggregation is the fuller description.

Sub-aspect of sacral_kingship (same A3, sole prereq): anointing/enthronement is how sacred kingship is conferred. No distinct choice; succession_oaths (A4) already covers binding the great men to the heir.

Third name for the same A3 temple ration lists: ration_distribution already issues rations to 'widows and orphans on their lists'. Fold its child-relief effect into the survivor (see ration_distribution fix-effect).
Same A5 capability and operand (mobility.promoteRatePerYear) as existing state_academy, whose own exemplar is the Han Taixue teaching the Confucian classics to officials (124 BCE).
Same A6 capability and operand (demographics.mortalityPerYear) as C3 public_hospitals, whose description is 'endowed hospitals'; the waqf/pious endowment is the funding form of the same institution.

Umbrella with no capability of its own: its stated content (education, property, professions, vote) is womens_higher_education, married_womens_property, womens_suffrage and equal_pay_law; three of those already use mobility.targetShareCap.
Not a selectable regime form (legitimacy lane); constitutional_monarchy + parliamentary_government already produce the ceremonial crown. Same capability under two names.
Same A9 capability (cross-border famine and child-feeding relief) as C4 international_food_aid; whether the agency is religious adds no mechanism.
Same A9 effect (demographics.mortalityPerYear) as existing environmental_regulation, and its only causal path is that law; movement and law are one capability in-sim.

Composite with no distinct capability: secular law, script reform and mass schooling are secular_state, script_reform and compulsory_education/mass_literacy_campaigns; overlaps developmentalism in the same lane and Age; generic civicsPoints effect.
New Liberalism and Progressivism are the same transatlantic reform movement (both from classical_liberalism); its insurance content is already social_insurance/unemployment_insurance/welfare_state.

Duplicate of existing stamp_seal (A2), which already carries consumption.grainSpoilagePerYear 0.03 precisely for sealing stores; sealing store doors is the stamp seal's use, not a separate capability.

Cross-group duplicate (C2 vs C3): both A3 temple/palace monthly rations of barley, oil and wool by list, both demographics.starvationMortalityMaxPerYear. Same Mesopotamian ration system under two names.

Duplicate of law_code: the distinction 'written for officials vs displayed for citizens' is false for law_code's own exemplar (Hammurabi's public stele invites any wronged man to read it); same operand society.grievanceRelief.
Cross-group duplicate (C2 vs C5), both A6 and both institutions.universities.maturityTauYears: the medieval law faculty (Bologna) IS the chartered university. Keep one node.

Cross-group duplicate (C3 vs C2), both A6: the village meeting/court limiting beasts on the common is literally part of village by-laws. Fold the herder effect into the survivor (see village_bylaws fix-effect).
Known duplicate: C3 equal_pay is word-for-word the same law as C2 equal_pay_law (same A9, same mobility.targetShareCap 0.03). Keep the C2 node.
Known duplicate: C3 refugee_protection = C2 refugee_law (non-refoulement + status; same A9, same migration.dampingDecayCostUnits 0.03). Keep the C2 node; update guest_worker_programmes.distinctFrom.
Cross-group duplicate (C3 vs C2), both A9 and both catchment.hinterlandRadiusKm: one authority running the region's transport so the commuting region works as one.
Same capability as existing 'Gift exchange networks' (shell, obsidian passed partner to partner over hundreds of km) and same operand trade.gapClosingFraction 0.02.

Existing road_paved (A5, Via Appia 312 BCE, a military road) already carries the state-reach role (governance.authorityDecayCostUnits) and the infra unlock; 'the state road network' is the same capability.

Same capability across groups (C4 A6 vs C2 A3) and same operand trade.costPerBulkCostUnit: a self-governing merchant colony abroad with its own judge. Rewire consular_service prereq to karum_courts AND resident_embassies.

Same capability (free plots and low dues offered to attract settlers to frontier land) and the same effect pair (migration.baseRatePerYear + colonization.orderPartyFraction) as existing settler_land_grants. If an A6 version is wanted, re-date the existing node instead of adding a second name.

The first joint-stock companies were the chartered companies (EIC 1600, VOC 1602); the chosen effect (price.stockReleaseRatePerYear) is a trading-firm effect, not the company-state role. If company rule is wanted it needs an authority-reach effect; as written it is joint_stock again.

Filler: troop timetabling is battle-layer (not live); roads.baselineKmPerDay is general overland speed, which military use of an existing railway does not raise. railway already carries the transport effects.
Bad effect and no live capability: reserve service is mobilization (battle layer), and returning conscripts home does not raise output per farmer (farming.outputPerFarmerPerYear).

Cross-group duplicate, both A9 and both production.outputPerExtractorPerYear 0.03: EEZ jurisdiction over fisheries vs catch quotas in those waters. Keep fisheries_management, which is the part that actually raises sustained yield.
supranational_union (C1 A9) already grants free movement of people with migration.baseRatePerYear 0.03; passport-free areas are the same capability with the same operand.
Sharing observations is the substance of synoptic_meteorology (A8) and numerical weather_prediction (A9, harvestVariance.sigmaLogYield 0.04); same operand, no distinct capability.

Filler: army lorry columns are battle-layer; roads.maxRouteKm duplicates highway_programmes (A9, same operand) and automobile_mass/motor_road.

No live capability (force composition is M7/M8) and migration.baseRatePerYear is not causally moved by ending conscription.

Filler: fifth A9 node on fog.exploreMaxRadiusNodes (with earth_observation, aerial_reconnaissance, satellite_reconnaissance, civil_space_agency) at 0.02, for a narrow capability with no distinct gameplay.
Cross-group duplicate, both A9 and both colonization.orderPartyFraction 0.03: the state plans and funds whole new settlements with towns, roads and services.
Filler: third A1 node with society.grievanceRelief 0.02 for 'binding the band' (with mortuary_rites and kin_council); no distinct role.

Cross-group duplicate (C5 vs C4), both A1: bands memorise landmarks and water holes to travel beyond their range. Same capability with fog operands split between two nodes; survivor may take exploreStepNodes as a second effect.

Intelsat consortium = existing communications_satellite (1962/1964 Syncom); institution and technology are the same capability.

Filler: same role as film_industry (mass-reproduced entertainment, A9 arts) and existing radio_broadcasting; generic grievanceRelief 0.02 with no distinct mechanism.
Two forms of the same A9 capability (the state pays artists); arm's-length vs direct commissioning is not a gameplay choice and the targetShareCap effect is not causally specific to art.
